title: fix(studio): the landing page names the .custom customization route, not the environment overlay
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBNo2iwVzPjRLwtsGTXAWgt)_

Fixes #29489

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6583617139).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 首页（App Builder）的页面说明和"已安装（只读）"区的提示语，英文与中文两份，不再叫用户"用环境覆盖定制"只读包，改为指向现有路径：打开条目，用「自定义」或「新建类似」，修改存进该包配对的 .custom 定制包，升级仍到达已安装的包。
- 为什么改：ADR-0146 D11 之后，不带包的写入落到已打包条目会被 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE 拒绝并点名 .custom 配对包；首页教的第一条路正是被拒的那条。
- 风险与回滚：只改两个文案值（en、zh）和 BuilderLanding.tsx 里两段注释，不加不删键，没有行为改动。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` 的 `engine.studio.landing.description` 与 `engine.studio.landing.readonlyHint`；重钉的 `BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171.test.ts`；新测试 `BuilderLanding.customizeCopy-29489.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.customizeCopy-29489.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171.test.ts`，预期 6 个用例全过（换回 main 的文案时其中 3 个转红）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`engine.studio.landing.description`** (en, zh): the page description's last clause said read-only packages are customized "with an environment overlay". It now says their items are changed with Customize or New similar, which save into the package's `.custom` customization package.
- **`engine.studio.landing.readonlyHint`** (en, zh): the read-only section's hint said "Customize one with an environment overlay, for the metadata types that accept one". It now says: open an item and choose Customize or New similar; the change is saved in the package's `.custom` customization package, and upgrades keep reaching the installed package. The comment above the en row names the routes that exist now.
- **`BuilderLanding.tsx`**: two code comments that still described a read-only package as customized by environment overlay now name its `.custom` pair. Comments only; no code changes.
- The words are the tables' own: the Customize and New similar action labels (`engine.studio.customize.action`, `engine.studio.auto.newSimilar.action`; zh 「自定义」, 「新建类似」), and zh 定制包 as in the landing's existing customization-package strings. No key is added or removed.
- **Where the keys live:** only in the Studio namespace tables (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` and `zh.ts`). None of the ten `locales/*.ts` packs carries `engine.studio.landing.*`, so the locale-pack parity tests do not read them, and only en and zh change.

## Tests

- **Re-pinned `BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171.test.ts`.** Same population (every designer table `readDesignerPairs` reads that carries the keys) and same reader control. The org-axis pin still covers all three keys. The pin that required every value to name the environment overlay is split: the two landing keys must name no environment overlay / 环境覆盖, and must name the `.custom` package and the table's own Customize label; `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint` keeps its environment-overlay assertion, which is now the matcher's lit control (that hint names the overlay because it says the overlay is refused).
- **New `BuilderLanding.customizeCopy-29489.test.tsx`.** Renders the real `BuilderLanding` with a read-only package in en and in zh (through `I18nProvider`, the zh studio catalogue preloaded at module scope). It reads the description and the hint off the page, checks they are the tables' rows, and checks each names `.custom`, Customize and New similar, with no overlay phrase.
- **Red on main:** with both tables restored to the main blob (`git restore --source=c88467d4`, mutation counted on disk: old en phrase 1, old zh phrase 1, new en phrase 0), 3 cases go red: the 12171 landing pin and both 29489 locale cases. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty, both blob hashes equal HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- **Does any metadata type still take a package-less environment overlay?** Not as a route the landing can offer. Read on `main` c88467d4: `packagelessCloseSubject` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`) closes the package-less save, publish, delete and rollback onto an item one read-only code package ships, wherever `os migrate packageless-overlays` could move its row, with `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` naming the pair (`packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal`). It stays open only for rows that ceremony leaves: an item more than one package ships, a base with no pair id, a stored row declaring a foreign override or shadowed by the pair, an `email_template` locale the base does not ship, or a base that records no version. A package-less row for a name no read-only package ships is environment metadata, not an overlay. The pin is the `metadata-protocol` suite "an item a CODE package ships: the package-less write is closed (ADR-0146 D11)" in `protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts`. Not confirmed live on a running server.
- **Noted, not changed:** `view` and `dashboard` (and `report`, `translation`, `email_template`) still declare `allowEnvironmentOverlay: true` in `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`). On the write, the D11 close wins: ADR-0146 D11 keeps the flag as the predicate the migration reads and the read path honours for an unmigrated row, not as a write door. The spec stays off this PR.
- **Noted, not changed:** `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyLink` ("Read-only · Customize with an overlay", zh 「只读 · 用覆盖定制」) is no longer rendered anywhere; only `StudioReadOnlyLink.overlay-27356.test.tsx` reads it, as the label that must be absent. It is a dead row teaching the closed route, invisible to users, and outside this card's surface.
- Docs and the turned-off sentence are #29374's and are untouched here.
